messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging SRE on-call: elevated gateway 5xx and streaming disconnects observed for region-us-west-2. Error spike started ~5m ago. Affected service: streaming-gateway (fanout). Impact: ~12% of streaming sessions seeing early EOF / 502 / connection reset. Alerting: paged.

sre-arnold: On it. pulling up dashboards. which customer(s) reporting visible errors?

cs-maya: We've got 2 enterprise customers reporting partial transcripts and dropped streams; one says client saw 'stream ended' mid-response. Tickets opened.

runtime-jen: Looking at runtime logs — I see connection resets from the gateway to runtime backends, many with `broken pipe` and chunked-encoding half-close. Also backend p50 latency up ~200ms. Possible downstream saturation.

platform-ali: Checking infra: GPU nodes look fine, CPU on the fanout workers spiked. Autoscale didn't kick for fanout because resource requests capped. Might be a concurrency surge.

sre-arnold: Immediate mitigations: 1) reduce fanout concurrency on gateway to 12 2) enable fallback-to-paginated for affected customer routes 3) increase connection timeouts on proxy to avoid premature resets. Who can flip those?

runtime-jen: I can push change to gateway feature flag `gateway.force_paged_on_unstable` for the affected customer IDs. Will do a canary for one customer first. Command: `./adminctl feature-toggle set gateway.force_paged_on_unstable customer:acct-42 true`

platform-ali: I'll patch the proxy config to raise keepalive and downstream timeout: nginx `proxy_read_timeout 120s; proxy_send_timeout 120s;` and tweak `proxy_buffering off;` to avoid chunk coalescing. Deploying to us-west-2 edge pool now.

incident-bot: Deploy job a123 queued by platform-ali. CI shows tests passing.

cs-maya: Notifying customers that we're investigating and may switch them to paged fallback. No ETA yet.

sre-arnold: Also enable connection-level circuit breaker to reject new fanout requests above 80% concurrency to stop overload cascade. platform-ali can set gateway config `fanout.max_concurrency = 12` and `fanout.reject_above = 0.8`.

platform-ali: Config change applied to gateway configmap and rolled to 3 nodes. Observability: inflight fanout per-request dropped from 40 -> ~10.

runtime-jen: After the paged fallback and concurrency cap, error rate dropped to ~3% and early EOFs are much lower. We still see periodic 502s from a specific backend pool (rt-pool-7). Fetching logs from that pool.

runtime-jen: Found one pattern: backend worker hitting `OOMKill` in rt-pool-7 when KV-cache grows for long sessions. Memory pressure plus heavy concurrency causes connection close mid-stream.

sre-arnold: Mitigation: reduce per-session KV cache size limit for that pool and restart pods on rt-pool-7 with a transient smaller cache. runtime-jen, can you push a rollout?

runtime-jen: Pushing image with `KV_CACHE_MAX_ITEMS=1024` and restarting rt-pool-7 with `kubectl rollout restart deployment/rt-pool-7`. Starting now.

pm-ryan: What's customer impact summary for page? We need to include ETA for full restore in the incident report.

cs-maya: Affected customers saw intermittent truncated responses for ~7-12 minutes. We provided a paged fallback to eliminate truncation for the worst hit. Next update to customers in 30m.

incident-bot: Post-mitigation checks: 1) error rate down to baseline for us-west-2 (from 12% -> 2.5%), 2) rt-pool-7 restarts completed, no new OOMs in last 10m, 3) paged fallback toggled for 2 enterprise routes.

sre-arnold: Good. Handoff to on-call lead for the next 2h monitoring window and post-incident followup. Action items: - capacity plan for fanout workers (autoscale threshold + headroom) - add alert for backend OOMKill pattern - add a playbook step to enable `force_paged` flag and customer comms template - investigate root cause of KV-cache growth for long sessions.

platform-ali: I'll schedule autoscale tuning and open an infra change PR.

runtime-jen: I'll add an eval to reproduce long-session KV growth and instrument memory usage.

cs-maya: I'll send customer update and open support case links in the incident doc.

sre-arnold: Thanks team. Marking incident as mitigated and creating incident ticket INC-2026-3509876543 with the summary. Handoff to @sre-ops for watch. :white_check_mark:
